title: AI Regulation for Donor Selection
description: Parliament must decide how to regulate the use of AI in organ donor selection. Some propose efficiency criteria, others privilege equity. Which law do you approve?

options.text: Approve a law that privileges medical efficiency, maximising success rates
A law imposing a fair rotation system to guarantee social justice
Regulation requiring human oversight for every critical decision

title: Anti-Discrimination Law in Selection AI
description: You must decide how to regulate the use of AI in hiring. Historical data show disparities, but a complete ban could reduce efficiency. Which legislative proposal do you support?

options.text: Allow the use of historical data without restrictions to maximise efficiency
A law imposing algorithmic corrections to guarantee equal opportunity
An absolute ban on using demographic data in selection processes

title: Law on Public Surveillance with AI
description: The Ministry of the Interior proposes a law to use AI in public surveillance to prevent crime. Civil rights groups oppose it. How do you vote?

options.text: Approve the law for comprehensive surveillance, prioritising national security
Approve with amendments that guarantee rigorous checks and transparency
Reject the proposal to protect citizens' privacy rights

title: Ethical Regulation of Autonomous Vehicles
description: You must establish ethical standards for autonomous vehicles. The trolley dilemma divides public opinion. Which regulation do you approve?

options.text: A regulation that privileges passenger safety as the absolute priority
A standard imposing the minimisation of total harm in every scenario
A regulation requiring emergency systems to stop the vehicle whenever possible

title: Data Privacy and Consent Law
description: You must regulate the use of personal data by companies. The technology industry asks for flexibility; privacy groups demand rigorous protections. Which law do you approve?

options.text: A permissive law allowing the use of data to improve services
A rigorous law requiring explicit consent for every use of data
Balanced regulation with an opt-in system and granular controls

title: National Plan for Automation and Work
description: You must approve a plan regulating AI automation. Companies demand freedom; unions demand protections. Which policy do you approve?

options.text: A plan allowing complete automation without restrictions, for competitiveness
A plan with gradual automation and state retraining programmes
Regulation limiting automation to preserve jobs

title: Anti-Disinformation and Deepfake Law
description: You must regulate synthetic content generation technologies. The media demand protections; researchers demand freedom. Which law do you approve?

options.text: Allow unrestricted use to foster innovation
A law imposing mandatory watermarking and authentication systems
Restrictive regulation limiting access to authorised researchers

title: Algorithmic Transparency Law
description: You must decide whether to require companies to make AI algorithms public. Industry opposes it; transparency groups support it. How do you vote?

options.text: Reject the law to protect intellectual property and competitiveness
Approve a law imposing full publication for public transparency
Approve a compromise: simplified public versions and external audits
